## Kibi Dango

![](../../assets/playable/inomissing/abilities/kibi_dango.png){ .entry-move-icon loading=lazy } *Active*

The user pulls a dango from their cheek. It costs hunger, more when several are made in a row. An animal or an NPC who ate a SMILE, given a dango, serves the user, it follows them, fights for them and obeys Command. A real Zoan user does not eat it. A second dango makes a servant stronger and tougher, and heals it. Sneaking and clicking a servant twice with an empty hand sends it away. A player who ate a SMILE and is given a dango cannot harm the user for a while, only where players may fight, then takes no dango for a while. Holding a dango or sneaking, the user sees a dango over the head of each servant.

## Kibi Dan-boshi

![](../../assets/playable/inomissing/abilities/kibi_dan_boshi.png){ .entry-move-icon loading=lazy } *Active*

The user throws a dango, the first animal or SMILE user it strikes eats it like a dango given by hand. A dango that misses falls on the ground. Each throw costs the hunger of a dango.
